gap: No result ChatGPT got states, for the 600 W kits side by side (ALLPOWERS P1800, R2500 V2 and R3500 with 600 W, BLUETTI Apex 300 + 3× 200 W, EcoFlow DELTA 3800 Gen4 + 640 W), how much of each battery the included panels refill in a day: on ChatGPT's own 1.8–2.4 kWh/day estimate, the 1,024 Wh and 1,920 Wh kits fill completely (94–100% for the 1,920 Wh one), while the 2.8–3.8 kWh kits it recommended refill only about 51–87%.
standout_why: Compared against StormWatts (cited), OutageReady, and Dealectric's own under-$3,000 and panels-included pages. StormWatts already defines usable panel watts as the smaller of panel watts and the station's solar cap, and has a refill-per-day column (about 65% for the DELTA 3800 Gen4 + 640 W). It lacks every ALLPOWERS kit, the Apex 300 + 3× 200 W kit and any cycle-life figure. OutageReady has no 600 W kit; it does give cycle-life bases (70% vs 80%) for Jackery, EcoFlow and Anker. Dealectric's under-$3,000 page already has the R3500 + SP039 at 5.3 sun-hours. So rivals have the method and one row; the new part is the other rows on one basis. The finding that would have scored higher, whether each station's input volts and amps let the included panels deliver their full 600 W, could not be sourced: iallpowers.com, us.ecoflow.com and the manual mirrors returned HTTP 429 or 403 on every product, spec and manual page.
decides: It confirms the pick rather than changing it. On the watt cap, no 600 W kit is clipped (600 W against caps of 650, 1,000, 2,000 and 2,400 W; 640 W against 2,000 W), so 'usable watts' eliminates nobody. Of the kits that ship now, the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP039 ($1,753.93 link price, $0.55/Wh) is the larger-battery pick, with the footnote that its 600 W refills about 57–76% of the battery per day. The ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W ($718.20 link price) is the only one whose panels fill the battery every day, in about 1.7 sun-hours at rated output. The BLUETTI Apex 300 + 3× 200 W states the strongest cycle-life basis (6,000 cycles to 80%) but is a late-January 2027 pre-order. The ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP039 is the middle option for a shopper who can wait until Dec 11. A caveat on cycle life: the ALLPOWERS figures (over 3,500 for the R3500, over 3,000 for the P1800) come with no capacity basis, so they cannot be ranked against BLUETTI's 6,000-to-80%.
